state: prepared; execution depends on accepted CP1
authority: Derived from the approved protocol, endpoint, identity and validation clauses. Does not alter scope or establish runtime readiness.
testApproach: Use actual Nest routes, session/CSRF/grant checks and PostgreSQL transactions. Fake only the external HTTP boundary. Add and execute new regressions as causal RED before their implementation; preserve the full API/ALL gates.

cases.proof: Absent, partial or malformed Instagram configuration disables only Instagram and makes zero provider calls. Public capability/DTO never exposes secrets. WhatsApp configuration cannot satisfy Instagram configuration.

cases.contract: BFF endpoint authorization and durable attempt ownership
cases.proof: Unauthenticated, wrong BU, insufficient role, missing CSRF and another actor/session cannot create, inspect, confirm, advance or cancel an attempt. Denial occurs before provider work and private candidate disclosure.

Same key/body returns the same reservation; mismatched body conflicts. Twenty overlapping requests claim once. Limits of ten attempts per actor/hour and thirty per BU/hour survive service recreation; rejection reports Retry-After without HTTP.

Wrong, missing, expired or replayed state, cross-session callback and concurrent callback lose before code exchange. Correct callback exchanges code once and redirects without code/state/token; no-store and no-referrer are present.

Code exchange targets the fixed Instagram endpoint. Missing management/messages permission, malformed or ambiguous envelope, invalid long-token expiry or failed exchange leaves active credentials untouched. Code is never persisted. Acquisition and actual expires_in support the sixty-second expiry margin.

cases.contract: app-scoped authorization reference distinct from /me user_id
cases.proof: Use synthetic references deliberately different from one another. Only the verified professional user_id binds entry.id/resource ownership; authorization id is preserved separately. No numeric conversion, username merge or user/browser-supplied peer/account authority.

cases.contract: explicit candidate confirmation and ownership before subscription
cases.proof: Candidate cannot send or announce receipt. Confirmation atomically claims the exact resource, associates the provider/channel and promotes ciphertext by current generation. Cross-BU owner and different-account reauthorization preserve losing credentials/grants. Subscription starts only after committed local mapping.

Timeout or inconclusive subscription cannot become a ready channel or blind repeated POST. Explicit advance observes before retry, with at most three ten-second requests, forty-second stage budget, sixty-second lease and ten-second cooldown. Concurrent advance cannot duplicate the mutation.

cases.contract: cancellation/disconnection preserve ownership and partial facts
cases.proof: Cancel and stale-generation confirmation race safely. Existing active token, retained business ownership, provider identity and message facts survive candidate cancellation. No deletion/revocation of other applications or remote ownership assumed.

cases.contract: dedicated GET challenge and raw signed POST
cases.proof: Challenge does not mark receipt. Missing, wrong or altered-byte signature fails before domain lookup/write. Explicit webhook app secret succeeds; OAuth/WhatsApp secrets fail even when configured. Same semantic JSON with different bytes cannot reuse a signature.

Small OAuth endpoints reject overflow. Instagram accepts a valid documented thousand-update batch without silent slicing, rejects over-limit bytes/update count before effects and preserves the existing WhatsApp envelope. Gateway parity is required at CP4, not inferred from Nest alone.

cases.contract: account/peer direction and opaque message identity
cases.proof: IN entry.id equals recipient professional account; sender is a qualified opaque peer. Echo reverses orientation. Equal external strings across two Instagram accounts or WhatsApp remain separate contacts/routes. Unknown/stale attachment cannot route to another connection.

cases.contract: signed original IN text timestamp qualifies human reply
cases.proof: Only eligible IN text supplies the response window. Missing/invalid or more-than-five-minute-future original timestamp, delayed old message, entry.time, echo/self/deleted/unsupported/read/reaction and local creation cannot open or extend it. No unsolicited initial or automation is enabled.

cases.contract: transactional acceptance and honest partial delivery
cases.proof: Twenty overlapping deliveries create one message, route and unread effect. A failure after part of a batch yields retryable failure; replay commits remaining work without duplicating prior accepted entries. Never acknowledge dropped work with HTTP 200.

cases.contract: receipt is proven only by accepted real-resource ingress
cases.proof: OAuth, /me, challenge and successful subscription remain pending receipt. Accepted signed synthetic provider text verifies only the configured synthetic resource. Unknown accounts, rejected signatures and stale generation cannot verify receiving. Real Meta/device evidence remains CP6.

Success/error DTOs, redirect headers, persisted history and client-visible events contain neither raw tokens/code/state nor raw provider response/URLs. Safe identifiers and state codes suffice to recover the attempt. Real secrets/logs remain outside this checkpoint.

laterRequired: CP3 shared outbound/policy/v2 cutover; CP4 UI and gateway/CI parity; CP5 full ALL, concurrency/performance and independent audits; CP6 separately approved real rollout and device proof.
notEvidence: No case has been run by preparing this plan. It grants no private-input, runtime, Meta, publication or product Git authority.
